At Servants Tree Service, we’re more than just a tree service company; we’re a team of passionate professionals who genuinely care about trees, safety, and the environment. Our mission is simple yet profound: to enhance the health and beauty of your trees while ensuring the safety of your property and loved ones.

You can trust that our team is trained, certified, and knowledgeable, with a deep understanding of tree care and maintenance. We are proud to serve North and Central Louisiana, and our dedication to the area is evident in our quality work and unwavering commitment to customer satisfaction.

Why Choose Us?

Expertise: Our team of licensed and experienced tree care professionals brings a wealth of expertise to every project.

Customer-Centric: Your satisfaction is our priority. We work closely with each client, understanding your unique needs and concerns, and tailor our services to exceed your expectations at a reasonable price. 

Safety First: Safety is a core value at Servants Tree Services. Our team is trained and equipped to handle any tree-related task with the utmost care and safety in mind.

Quality Assurance: Every project we undertake is executed with precision and attention to detail. We believe in doing the job right the first time, ensuring the health and longevity of your trees.
